sentences.text:
As per FIR, allegation is that a raid was conducted by the police, upon secret information wherein,
several persons were apprehended who were involved in cybercrime.
On disclosure made by the apprehended accused persons, other places were also raided and the present petitioners were apprehended.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the petitioners are innocent and have committed no offence at all rather they have been falsely implicated in this case.
No incriminating articles have been recovered from the petitioners and they have no concern with cybercrime rather they are innocent persons.
After completion of investigation, charge-sheet has been submitted against the petitioners.

Petitioners undertake to co-operate with the trial of the case and remain physically present on each and every date till the conclusion of the trial and shall not indulge in tampering with the prosecution evidence or influence the witnesses or gain over them.
The petitioners are languishing in judicial custody without any rhymes and reasons.
Hence the petitioners may be enlarged on bail.
6. Learned Addl. P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioners.

7. Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation against petitioners coupled with materials available on record and period of custody of the petitioners, I am inclined to release the above named petitioners, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioners named above, are directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-I, Jamtara in connection with Jamtara Cyber Crime P.S. Case No. 05 of 2024 with condition that petitioners shall appear physically on each and every date during the trial of case till its conclusion unless their physical appearances are dispensed with for sufficient cause to the satisfaction of the learned trial court and with further condition that petitioners shall not indulge in tampering with the prosecution evidence or influence the witnesses or gain over them.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Pappu/
